name: IdPVault
description: Self-hosted backup, drift detection, and restore for identity providers (Authentik, Okta, and Auth0). Encrypted configuration snapshots on a schedule, a diff of every change, selective restore with dry-run preview, and Users and Access backup/restore on paid tiers. No telemetry, no phone-home; license keys verify offline. Free Community tier included (1 tenant). Requires a PostgreSQL database - install any PostgreSQL container from CA and point the Database URL below at it. The encryption master key generates itself on first boot in the Secrets path: back that folder up and never delete it, or existing snapshots become unreadable. The container runs as a non-root user (uid 10001). If it fails to start with permission errors, run: chown -R 10001:10001 /mnt/user/appdata/idpvault

paths.name: Secrets
paths.description: Holds the auto-generated encryption master key. BACK THIS FOLDER UP and never delete it - snapshots cannot be decrypted without it.
